name: Vase of the Abyss (Quy Khư Bình)
lore: A plain unglazed clay vase the height of a forearm, cold to the touch in any weather, said to hold a sea. Mạc Quy Khư carried it out of Phù Tang Cảnh in the year 0 (C001); it is older than the calendar. At his tribulation in 260 it drank the bolts meant for him (C029), and what it spilled tore open the realm of fire and snow. No one but its holder knows this. Legendary item quy_khu_binh.
build_use: The old man's last line: linh lực and a Thunder ward, and one blow a fight that simply goes into the clay.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Lone Crane (Cô Hạc)
effects: A Crane Crosses from the East
lore: A long, narrow sword of Can Tương ore with a grey crane cut into the guard, named for Tô Thức's crane crossing the river from the east. Quách Lĩnh Thù, founder of Phất Y Cốc, forged it in 760 for his own Wind and gave it to Tư Không Hạc Niên at dawn in Tống Khách Thị in 900 before he walked away (A138). Tư Không is pure Metal and has never woken its wind. Legendary item co_hac; its maker was unknown in the chronicle (made_by null) and is named here.
build_use: The sage's edge: sword attack and speed. Its real rule waits for a Wind root.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Mirror of Seas and Fields (Thương Tang Kính)
effects: The Blue Sea Becomes Mulberry Fields
lore: A bronze hand mirror whose back is cast with waves on one half and mulberry rows on the other. It came from Cô Phàm Các's sea hall, and Yến Tang Điền searched the western sea with it for 355 years. In 1060 it was in his disciple's hands when the tribulation struck, and it is the reason Đoạn Thương Hải lived (C180). Its face is a Light treasure; Đoạn has not seen it since. Legendary item thuong_tang_kinh.
build_use: The blind man's shield: soul and Thunder resistance, and one bolt a fight that goes into the glass.

name: North-Wind Breath (Sóc Khí)
lore: Hoắc Hàn Quang forged it in 300 from glacier ice and the iron of the southern massif (Mộc Lan Thi: the north wind carries the watchman's gong; cold light shines on iron mail). In 699 he laid it on the stone of his cave and walked north with empty hands on Mạc Quy Khư's advice, and died (C014). Kỷ Hoa Ảnh sealed the cave with the sword inside in 702. Legendary item soc_khi, slot A-1 (the legendary text says 'sealed with him'; Lê Hoa Am's page has the cave empty and the sword alone in it, which this file follows).
build_use: An ice duelist's sword: Ice attack and crits that freeze into lightning. Whoever takes it takes the storm with it.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Purple Smoke Furnace (Tử Yên Lô)
lore: A three-legged bronze burner gone violet with smoke, made in 500 and named for Lý Bạch's Incense Burner Peak, where the sun makes purple smoke. Cao Đan Hà's furnace, standing in her sealed abode beside the pill that killed her (C022). Úy Thanh Diễm and Đồng Hồng Lô both want it; Khuyết Vãn Hà knows where it is. Legendary item tu_yen_lo, slot A-2. There is no furnace base; the incense burner (huong_lo) stands in.
build_use: An alchemist's heirloom: poison resistance and healing in a fight, and the best furnace on the continent outside one.

name: Blazing Sun Fan (Diễm Dương Phiến)
lore: A fan of red iron ribs and fire-silk made by Cung Hỏa Vân in 450, the year he went to live in the cape's vents after the fire of Mạc Quy Khư's tribulation. It lies in his abode where his body was found burned on one side and frozen on the other (C013). Hồng Lô Cốc's founder came to the cape looking for its fire. Legendary item diem_duong_phien, slot A-4.
build_use: A fire caster's fan: Fire attack and long burns, and an answer to frost.

name: Plum of the Fifth Month (Ngũ Nguyệt Mai)
lore: A jade flute that unscrews into a short blade, made by Lương Lạc Mai in 600 and named for Lý Bạch's line: in the river city in the fifth month, the falling-plum tune is played on the flute. It lies with her in her sealed abode (C020). Her death has never been explained, and the flute is the clue. Legendary item ngu_nguyet_mai, slot A-5. No flute base exists; phi_kiem stands in.
build_use: A flute-sword for a Wind duelist: art speed and long statuses, cuts that are also songs.

name: Bead of the Unmoving Hour (Bất Động Thời Châu)
lore: A bead of clear stone with a grain of sand that has hung in its middle, not falling, for a thousand years.
build_use: Time held still: long statuses and linh lực.

build_use: The edge, and the crits that wake the afterimages.
